mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% over three months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where RSAFS increased by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a tight labor market with strong job growth, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% month-over-month and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals a strong demand in both housing and consumer sectors, which boosts corporate revenues and earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% and RSAFS increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% and RSAFS increased by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.2% month-over-month signals easing inflationary pressures, which reduces the likelihood of monetary tightening and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where CPIAUCSL decreased by more than 0.2% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) increases by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter and industrial production (INDPRO) increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 1% QoQ and INDPRO increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 increased by more than 1% QoQ and INDPRO increased by more than 0.5% in a month.
